name: aggregate-reporting
summary: Reporting agents aggregate allow-listed PostgreSQL tables and never read rows: aggregates use public and internal columns only, return at most 100 groups, and small groups are suppressed.
covers: aggregates only: row reads are denied
data classes: pii and secret columns never reach the agent
at most 100 groups per aggregate, small groups suppressed by the connection
a grant baseline covering aggregates and the table list only
